gabor_orientation_fit.method: Blender draws the Orientation 3D socket as a direction ball lit by the vector (x = screen right, y = screen up, z = toward viewer: Blender UNITVEC widget). Inside the ball we fitted brightness = gain * max(0, n.w) + offset over all pixels (n = sphere normal from the circle) and solved for the unit vector w.

validation.note: mouse cursor over the ball raises the error; the default is recovered within ~0.01 in x/y

gabor_orientation_fit.uncertainty: +-0.02 per component; z ~ 0 is consistent with the drag ending outside the circle (rim clamp)
